```{r set environment}

library(tidyverse)

library(ppmlasso)
library(splines)
library(pROC)

library(sf)
library(terra)
library(spatstat)

rm(list = ls())

source("fun/fix_ppmlasso.R")
source("fun/myUtilities.R")

res <- 250

paths <- list(bg = paste0("data/bg",res,"m.rds"),
              studyArea = "data/SpatialData/contour-des-departements.geojson",
              collisions = "data/CollisionData/synthese_observations_2025-03-24T10_12_28.148Z.geojson")

```

```{r load and prepare data}

studyArea <- read_sf(paths$studyArea) %>%
  filter(code %in% c(22,29,56)) %>%
  select(geometry, code) %>%
  st_transform(2154) %>%
  st_union

bg <- readRDS(paths$bg) %>%
  filter(roadImportance > 0) %>%
  mutate(maxStra = ifelse(crossings3, straCross, maxStra),
         maxStra = ifelse(maxStra == 8, 7, maxStra),
         roadImportance = ifelse(crossings3, roadCross, roadImportance))

bg <- bg[!sapply(st_within(st_as_sf(bg, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 2154), studyArea), is_empty), ]

collisions <- read_sf(paths$collisions) %>%
  filter(year(date_debut) > 2000) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 2154) %>%
  st_intersection(st_union(studyArea))

```

### 1. Fit main model

##### a. Set up main model

```{r set up main model, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

rad <- 1000

spxy <- collisions %>%
  st_coordinates %>%
  as.data.frame

myppmdata <- ppmdat(sp.xy = spxy, back.xy = bg, 
                    coord = c("X", "Y"), sp.scale = res, writefile = FALSE)

```

##### b. Fit main model

```{r fit main model}

form <- ~ (rivers == 0) + (otterPresence != 0) +
  crossings3 * (roads + altitude + cultures + treeCover + wetlands  +
                  rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                  exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/2500) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500))

fit <- ppmlasso(form, data = myppmdata, n.fits = 20, sp.scale = res, coord=c("X","Y"),
                r = rad, family = "area.inter", 
                standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)

out <- mutate(bg,
              mu = fit$mu[(nrow(spxy)+1):length(fit$mu)]*250**2,
              pt.interactions = fit$pt.interactions[(nrow(spxy)+1):length(fit$pt.interactions)])

out <- write_rds(out, paste0("out/out250m.rds"))
```

##### c. Plot main model's output

```{r plot main - risk map}

ggplot(out) + 
  geom_tile(aes(x = X, y = Y, fill = log(mu)), col = NA) + 
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_c("grDevices::Lajolla", name = "log(\u00B5)")+
  coord_fixed() + 
  theme_void()

ggsave(filename = "out/riskMap.png", width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")

```

```{r, variable contribution}

forms <- list(`river-crossing` = ~ (rivers == 0) + roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover  + rivers +
                                ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500),
              `river density` = ~ 
                crossings3 * (roads + otterPresence + altitude + cultures + treeCover  +
                                ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
              `road density` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * ((otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover  +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
              `strahler order` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover  +
                                rivers + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
              `road importance class` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover  +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
              `otter presence` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + altitude + cultures + treeCover  +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
            ` farmland cover` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + treeCover  +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
             `altitude` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + cultures + treeCover  +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
             `tree cover` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + 
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
             `dist. waterbody` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
             `dist. coast` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)),
             `dist. urban` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distRoad/500)), 
             `dist. road` = ~ (rivers == 0) + 
                crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + altitude + cultures + treeCover +
                                rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
                                exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) + exp(-distUrban/500))
              
  )

myppmdata_lowres <- ppmdat(sp.xy = spxy, back.xy = bg, 
                    coord = c("X", "Y"), sp.scale = 1000, writefile = FALSE)

fit_ref <-  ppmlasso(form, data = myppmdata_lowres, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = 1000, coord=c("X","Y"),
                     r = 2000, family = "area.inter", 
                     standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)

fits <- map(forms, ~ ppmlasso(.x, data = myppmdata_lowres, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = 1000, coord=c("X","Y"),
                              r = 2000, family = "area.inter", 
                              standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE))

fits <- append(fits, 
               list(clustering = ppmlasso(form, data = myppmdata_lowres, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = 1000, coord=c("X","Y"),
                                               standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)))

data.frame(dL = fit_ref$likelihood - reduce(map(fits, "likelihood"), c),
           var = names(fits)) %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_col(aes(x = reorder(var, -dL), y = dL)) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 5), linetype = "dashed") +
  ylab("log-likelihood loss") + xlab("")+
  theme_bw() + 
  facet_wrap(~dL<10, scale = "free_x", nrow = 2)+
  theme(axis.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank())

ggsave(filename = "out/covContribution.png", width = 25, height = 12.5, units = "cm")
```

```{r mitigation implications}

risk_dat <- mutate(out, 
                   id = 1:n())

risk_dat <- st_buffer(st_as_sf(risk_dat, coords = c("X", "Y"),
                                     crs = 2154),
                            dist = 125, endCapStyle = "SQUARE") %>%
  st_intersection(collisions) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(ncoll = n()) %>% 
  right_join(risk_dat) %>%
  mutate(ncoll = replace_na(ncoll, 0))

risk_dat_road <- risk_dat %>%
  filter(crossings3==0) %>% 
  arrange(desc(mu)) %>% 
  mutate(cum_colls = cumsum(ncoll),
         length_mitig = cumsum(roads))

risk_dat_cross <- risk_dat %>%
  filter(crossings3==1) %>% 
  arrange(desc(mu)) %>% 
  mutate(cum_colls = cumsum(ncoll),
         nCross = 1:n())

p21 <- ggplot(risk_dat_road)+
  geom_line(aes(x = length_mitig/1000, y = cum_colls), col = "blue")+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = length_mitig/1000, ymin = 0,
                  ymax = mu/max(mu)*500),
              alpha = .5, fill = "lightblue")+
  geom_path(data = data.frame(),
            aes(x = c(-Inf, 1004, 1004), y = c(187, 187, -Inf)), linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(),
            aes(x = 1004, y = 187), size = 3) +
  xlim(c(0,10000)) +
  xlab("Length of roads with mitigation (km)") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Max. collisions avoided",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(trans=~./500*max(risk_dat_road$mu),
                                          name="Collision risk"),
                     limits = c(0,250)
  )+
  theme_bw()+ 
  theme(text = element_text(face = "bold"))

p22 <- ggplot(risk_dat_cross)+
  geom_line(aes(x = nCross, y = cum_colls), col = "red")+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = nCross, ymin = 0,
                  ymax = mu/max(mu)*50), alpha = .5, fill = "orange")+
  geom_path(data = data.frame(),
            aes(x = c(-Inf, 96, 96), y = c(57, 57, -Inf)), linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(),
            aes(x = 96, y = 57), size = 3) +
  xlim(c(0,250)) +
  xlab("Number of crossings with mitigation") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Max. collisions avoided",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(trans=~./50*max(risk_dat_cross$mu),
                                          name="Collision risk")
  )+
  theme_bw()+ 
  theme(text = element_text(face = "bold"))

p23 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = studyArea)+
  geom_tile(data = filter(out, roadImportance <= 3), aes(x = X, y = Y), col = NA, alpha = 0.33) + 
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_c("grDevices::Lajolla", name = "log(\u00B5)")+
  geom_point(data = filter(risk_dat_road, length_mitig <= 1004000),
            aes(x=X, y = Y), pch = 15, size = .25, col = "blue", col = NA)  +
  geom_point(data = filter(risk_dat_cross, nCross <= 96),
            aes(x=X, y = Y),col = "red") +
  theme_void()

ggpubr::ggarrange(ggpubr::ggarrange(p21, p22, nrow = 2), p23, ncol = 2, widths = c(0.4, 0.6))

ggsave(filename = "out/mitigationImplications.png", width = 29.7, height = 21, units = "cm")

```

### 3. Check clustering

```{r check clustering}

lamb <- ifelse(exists("fit"), fit$lambda, 21.44)

rads <- c(0, 1000, 2000, 4000) 
fams <- c("area.inter", "poisson")[(rads == 0) +1]

fits <- map2(fams, rads, 
             ~ ppmlasso(form, data = myppmdata, family = .x, r = .y, lamb = lamb, 
                        sp.scale = res, coord=c("X","Y"), standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)) %>%
  map(~ .x$mu[(nrow(spxy)+1):(nrow(spxy)+nrow(bg))]) %>%
  reduce(cbind)

study_win <- as.owin(st_union(studyArea))

bg_rast <- rast(xmin = study_win$xrange[1], xmax = study_win$xrange[2],
                ymin = study_win$yrange[1], ymax = study_win$yrange[2],
                resolution = res, crs = "EPSG:2154")

bg_sf <- st_as_sf(bg, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = 2154) %>%
  select 

bg_sf <- cbind(bg_sf, fits)
colnames(bg_sf)[1:length(rads)] <- rads

out_rasts <- map(as.character(rads), 
               ~ rasterize(bg_sf, bg_rast, field = .x, background = 0))

true_pp <- ppp(spxy$X, spxy$Y, window = as.owin(st_union(studyArea)))

Kinhom_envelopes <- map(1:length(rads),
                        ~ envelope(true_pp, Kinhom, nsim = 99,
                                   simulate = expression(
                                     rpoispp(lambda = as.im(stars::st_as_stars(out_rasts[[.x]])),
                                             lmax = max(fits[[.x]]),
                                             win = study_win))))

Kinhom_envelopes <- map2(Kinhom_envelopes, as.character(rads),
                         ~ mutate(as.data.frame(.x), rad = paste0("interaction radius: ", .y))) %>%
  reduce(rbind)

ggplot(Kinhom_envelopes) +
  geom_line(aes(x = r, y = sqrt(obs) - sqrt(r)), col = "red", linewidth = .75)+
  geom_line(aes(x = r, y = sqrt(mmean) - sqrt(r)), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = .75)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = r, ymin = sqrt(lo) - sqrt(r), ymax = sqrt(hi)- sqrt(r)), alpha = .5)+
  xlim(c(0,10000))+ylim(c(0,22000))+
  ylab(expression(sqrt(hat(K)) - sqrt(r)))+
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(rad, levels = paste0("interaction radius: ", rads)), nrow = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.background = element_blank())

```

### 4. Effect of thinning

```{r fit models to thinned data}

form_bis <- ~ (rivers == 0) + crossings3 * ns(maxStra, df = 3) + roads + (otterPresence != 0) + 
  altitude + cultures + treeCover + wetlands  + rivers + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
  exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/2500) + exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500)

ncoll <- nrow(spxy)

lamb <- fit$lambda

thinning_lvls <- c(rep(c(80, 120, 160, 200, 240, 280), each = 10), nrow(collisions))

myppmdata_lowres <- ppmdat(sp.xy = spxy,
                            back.xy = bg, sp.scale = 1000, 
                            coord = c("X", "Y"), writefile = FALSE)

fit_lowres <- ppmlasso(form_bis, data = myppmdata_lowres, lamb = lamb, sp.scale = 1000, 
                       r = 2000, family = "area.inter",
                       coord=c("X","Y"), standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)

mu_nothin <- predict.ppmlasso(object = fit_lowres, newdata = bg,
                              interactions = rep(0, nrow(bg)))

myppmdata_thinned <- map(thinning_lvls, ~ c(sample(1:ncoll, .x),
                                            (ncoll+1):nrow(myppmdata_lowres))) %>%
  map(~myppmdata_lowres[.x, ])

fit_thinned <- map(myppmdata_thinned, 
                   ~ ppmlasso(form_bis, data = .x, lamb = lamb, sp.scale = 1000, 
                              r = 2000, family = "area.inter", 
                              coord=c("X","Y"), standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE))

mu_thinned <- map(fit_thinned, ~ predict.ppmlasso(object = .x, newdata = bg,
                                                  interactions = rep(0, nrow(bg))))

spear <-  map(mu_thinned, ~ cor(.x[bg$roadImportance <= 3],
                                  mu_nothin[bg$roadImportance <= 3],
                                  method = "spearman")) %>%
  reduce(c)

jaccard <- function(a, b){
  u <- intersect(a,b)
  length(u) / (length(a) + length(b) - length(u))
}

jacc <-  map(mu_thinned, ~ jaccard(which(.x > quantile(.x, 0.95)),
                                   which(mu_nothin > quantile(mu_nothin, 0.95)))) %>%
  reduce(c)

p1 <- data.frame(thin = thinning_lvls,
                 spearman_coeff = spear,
                 jaccard_coeff= jacc) %>%
  group_by(thin)%>%
  summarize(inf = quantile(jaccard_coeff, 0.25),
            med = quantile(jaccard_coeff, 0.5),
            sup = quantile(jaccard_coeff, 0.75)) %>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_pointrange(aes(x = thin, ymin = inf, y = med, ymax =  sup))+
  xlab("number of collision records") + ylab("Jaccard coefficient")+
  theme_bw()

```

```{r covariate stability}

pred_all <- imap(mu_thinned,
                 ~ mutate(bg,
                          mu = .x,
                          id = .y,
                          thinning = thinning_lvls[.y]) %>%
                   filter(1:n() %in% sample(1:n(), 50000))) %>%
  reduce(rbind) %>%
  filter(thinning %in% c(80, 160, 240, 326))


pred_all_longer <- pivot_longer(pred_all,
                                cols = c("roadImportance", "maxStra",
                                         "distRoad", "otterPresence",
                                         "treeCover", "distLake", "roads"))
  
p2 <- ggplot() +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name != "maxStra", thinning != 326), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), color = factor(thinning), group = id),
                se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.33, method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name != "maxStra", thinning == 326), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), group = id),
                se = FALSE, col = "black", method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name == "maxStra", 
                              crossings3 == 0, thinning != 326), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), color = factor(thinning), 
                    group = id),
                se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.33, method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name == "maxStra", 
                              crossings3 == 0, thinning == 326), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), group = id),
                se = FALSE, col = "black", method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
  geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name == "maxStra", 
                              crossings3 == 1, thinning != 326), 
              aes(x = value, y = log(mu), color = factor(thinning), 
                  group = id),
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.33, linetype = "dashed",
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name == "maxStra", 
                              crossings3 == 1, thinning == 326), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), group = id),
                se = FALSE, col = "black", linetype = "dashed",
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "number of collision records")+
  xlab("") +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggpubr::ggarrange(p1, p2, widths = c(0.33, 0.66))
```

### 5. Stability to alternative covariate definitions

```{r stability to covs.}

form1 <- ~ (rivers == 0) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
  crossings1 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + 
                  altitude + cultures + treeCover + wetlands  +
                  rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + 
                  exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) +
                  exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500))

form2 <- ~ (rivers == 0) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
  crossings2 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + 
                  altitude + cultures + treeCover + wetlands  +
                  rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + 
                  exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) +
                  exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500))

form3 <- ~ (rivers == 0) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
  crossings3 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + 
                  altitude + cultures + treeCover + wetlands  +
                  rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + 
                  exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) +
                  exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500))

form4 <- ~ (rivers == 0) + ns(roadImportance, df = 3) + 
  crossings4 * (roads + (otterPresence != 0) + 
                  altitude + cultures + treeCover + wetlands  +
                  rivers + ns(maxStra, df = 3) + 
                  exp(-distLake/1000) + exp(-distCoast/10000) +
                  exp(-distUrban/500) + exp(-distRoad/500))

fit1 <- ppmlasso(form1, data = myppmdata, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = res, coord=c("X","Y"),
                r = rad, family = "area.inter", standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)
fit2 <- ppmlasso(form2, data = myppmdata, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = res, coord=c("X","Y"),
                r = rad, family = "area.inter", standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)
fit3 <- ppmlasso(form3, data = myppmdata, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = res, coord=c("X","Y"),
                r = rad, family = "area.inter", standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)
fit4 <- ppmlasso(form4, data = myppmdata, lamb = fit$lambda, sp.scale = res, coord=c("X","Y"),
                r = rad, family = "area.inter", standardise = TRUE, writefile = FALSE)

mu1 <- predict.ppmlasso(object = fit1, newdata = bg, interactions = rep(0, nrow(bg)))*res**2
mu2 <- predict.ppmlasso(object = fit2, newdata = bg, interactions = rep(0, nrow(bg)))*res**2
mu3 <- predict.ppmlasso(object = fit3, newdata = bg, interactions = rep(0, nrow(bg)))*res**2
mu4 <- predict.ppmlasso(object = fit4, newdata = bg, interactions = rep(0, nrow(bg)))*res**2

jaccard <- function(a, b){
  u <- intersect(a,b)
  length(u) / (length(a) + length(b) - length(u))
}
jacc1 <- jaccard(which(mu1> quantile(mu1, 0.95)),
                 which(mu3 > quantile(mu3, 0.95)))
jacc2 <- jaccard(which(mu2> quantile(mu2, 0.95)),
                 which(mu3 > quantile(mu3, 0.95)))
jacc3 <- jaccard(which(mu3> quantile(mu3, 0.95)),
                 which(mu3 > quantile(mu3, 0.95)))
jacc4 <- jaccard(which(mu4> quantile(mu4, 0.95)),
                 which(mu3 > quantile(mu3, 0.95)))

p1 <- data.frame(treatment = c("cross1", "cross2", "cross3", "cross4"),
                 lik = c(fit1$likelihood, fit2$likelihood, fit3$likelihood, fit4$likelihood))%>%

  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = treatment, y = lik))+
  xlab("") + ylab("Model log likelihood")+
  theme_bw()

p2 <- data.frame(treatment = c("cross1", "cross2", "cross3", "cross4"),
                 jacc = c(jacc1, jacc2, jacc3, jacc4)) %>%

  ggplot()+
  geom_point(aes(x = treatment, y = jacc))+
  xlab("") + ylab("Jaccard coefficient")+
  theme_bw()

pred_all <- imap(list(cross1 = mu1, cross2 = mu2, cross3 = mu3,
                       cross4 = mu4),
                  ~ mutate(bg, mu = .x, treatment = .y)) %>%
  reduce(rbind) %>%
  mutate(otterDensity = otterDensity *1e06)
  
pred_all_longer <- pivot_longer(pred_all,
                                cols = c("roadImportance", "maxStra",
                                         "distRoad", "otterPresence",
                                         "treeCover", "distLake", "roads")) %>%
  filter(!((name %in% c("distLake", "distRoad"))&(value>5000)))
  
p3 <- ggplot() +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name != "maxStra"), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), color = treatment),
                se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.33, method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
    geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name == "maxStra", 
                              crossings3 == 0), 
                aes(x = value, y = log(mu), color = treatment),
                se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.33, method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
  geom_smooth(data = filter(pred_all_longer, name == "maxStra", 
                            crossings3 == 1), 
              aes(x = value, y = log(mu), color = treatment),
              se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.33, linetype = "dashed",
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ ns(x, df = 3)) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "")+
  xlab("") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggpubr::ggarrange(ggpubr::ggarrange(p1, p2), p3, nrow = 2, heights = c(0.33,0.66))
ggsave("out/supp_altCovs.png", width = 21, height = 15, units = "cm" )
```
